column1: # Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# The player's own profile for this fork (the game has none upstream): the memory values are still the survey's provisional ones, not checked by hand.
# Played on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Adreno 750, Android 16): with the online SDK loaded the game boots to its logo screen at 60 fps and goes on to
# its main menu at 40 fps (2026-11-24). The intro video's context crashes in the game's own code - a null member reference from its Mono lookup - and two cuts in the
# game's own main (patches.py) turn that into a clean failure, so the intro video is skipped and the game carries on.
# DM_ONLINE_SDK=1 lets the host load the game's Epic Online Services NRO (hle_ro.c); without it the game crashes at its start-up (a null online object).
